name: paper-conductor
description: 论文流水线总调度 / Academic paper pipeline conductor: routes between independent academic skills by stage, with per-stage handoff.

plugins.name: paper-conductor
plugins.description: Stage-based orchestration layer for academic paper writing. Navigates 8 stages (topic → research → draft → figures → polish → review → defense → submission), recommends the right skill per stage, and defines handoffs. Does not write/polish/review/draw itself.
